input.answer: The job vacancy rate for Canada in August 2026 was 2.9% on the unadjusted series (table 14-10-0371). The seasonally adjusted series (table 14-10-0432) shows 2.8% for the same month. The unadjusted figure is the direct answer to "August 2026"; the adjusted figure is shown for comparison. The search card listed these tables as running to 2026-07, but the get_series call returned August 2026 data for both, so I used it. No values were suppressed.
